text:
maria_support: FYI customer reported a behavioral regression after the 08:37 deploy. They say assistant is ignoring the system instruction in a few prompts. attaching repro.

maria_support: Repro steps: 1) send chat with system:

```
System: You are a concise assistant that always prefixes answers with [NOTE].
User: Summarize the following: 'Q1 results show 12% growth'
```

Expected: response starts with [NOTE] and a short summary. Got: full paragraph with no prefix and different wording. Customer claims started ~08:45 after our runtime rollout.

devin_engineer: Can you paste the full request (headers+body) and model id? Also which template revision did we push to canary?

maria_support: curl dump below (redacted key) + model: redwood/gptx-3.2-chat@v2026-03-17-template-b

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/chat \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/gptx-3.2-chat@v2026-03-17-template-b","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a concise assistant that always prefixes answers with [NOTE]."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the following: Q1 results show 12% growth"}]}'
```

lena_ml: I looked at the template change — we trimmed leading/trailing whitespace in the system message and enabled unicode_normalize=true in tokenizer config (PR #5421). That could change token offsets for messages that started with a NBSP or special characters.

oscar_sre: deploy_bot shows canary rollout at 10% at 08:35, full rollout at 08:50 (deploy id: deploy-2026-03-17-08).

devin_engineer: If unicode normalization removed a leading non-breaking space, the tokenization of the system message shifts and the model may no longer see the system directive as the same token sequence. That can change downstream generation. We need a quick repro that demonstrates byte/character differences + model logits if possible.

maria_support: Customer provided a before/after pair. Before (old template):

"messages": [{"role":"system","content":"\u00A0You are a concise assistant that always prefixes answers with [NOTE]."}, ...]

After (new template normalized):

"messages": [{"role":"system","content":"You are a concise assistant that always prefixes answers with [NOTE]."}, ...]

They said just removing that NBSP made the prefix disappear in outputs for ~4 out of 10 similar prompts.

lena_ml: That matches: NBSP can be part of tokenization that causes early special-token alignment. Small shifts in tokenization at the start can change the model's attention to the system instruction. This is a regression risk for chat templates.

oscar_sre: We should pause the rollout. Can we revert template-b on the canary hosts and redeploy previous template version to the remaining fleet?

devin_engineer: I can push a canary revert within 20m. Need approvals: rollback to redwood/gptx-3.2-chat@v2026-03-10-template-a. Also request to disable unicode_normalize in tokenizer on the chat path until we have regression tests.

maria_support: Customer is asking for status and reproduction logs. They want a timeline and rollback. Marking P1 and offering to escalate credits if needed.

lena_ml: I'll run a quick fuzz harness that seeds leading whitespace variants (space, NBSP, zero-width joiner) against the model and record divergence score. If we see >0.2 KL shift on system-token logits we can consider that a blocker.

devin_engineer: For immediate customer repro here is a minimal script to compare tokenization differences locally:

```python
from tokenizer import encode
old = '\u00A0You are a concise assistant...'.encode('utf-8')
new = 'You are a concise assistant...'.encode('utf-8')
print(encode(old))
print(encode(new))
```

oscar_sre: deploy_bot: rollback queued by devops (job rollback-template-b -> template-a). ETA 18m. Notifying infra pager.

maria_support: I'll tell the customer we're rolling back canary and investigating root cause; asking if they'd like us to run their prompt against the canary and the rolled-back template and share diffs.

lena_ml: After rollback we should add a gate: any tokenizer or template change must include a regression harness that fuzzes leading/trailing whitespace and common unicode variants. I'll open an RFC for a gating test.

devin_engineer: Action items: 1) rollback canary (devin) 2) run fuzz harness (lena) 3) send customer diffs & timeline (maria) 4) add gating tests + disable unicode_normalize flag until vetted (devin+lena).

maria_support: Customer updated: appreciates fast response, will wait for diffs. Marking thread for follow-up when rollback complete. :thumbsup:

deploy_bot: deploy-2026-03-17-08: canary rollback job started by devin_engineer (job id rb-98765).

oscar_sre: keeping this thread on pager until rollback finishes. If rollback completes and customer still sees issue, escalate to oncall model team.

maria_support: I'll update support ticket and put a note in the CS dashboard.

lena_ml: Note for postmortem: tokenizer normalization can be non-idempotent w.r.t. instruction-following behavior. Need to capture in docs.

maria_support: thanks everyone, will follow up with the customer after rollback and attach test outputs.
